slug: 2024-06-11 Review of Somalia's Data Protection Act and implementing regulations

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory states the Data Protection Act was enacted on 23 March 2023 and became effective immediately throughout Somalia, as the country's first comprehensive data protection law.
The Act established the Somalia Data Protection Authority, which the review says was officially launched in February 2024 and commenced activities before then.

The review states that under Article 41 the Authority issued the Implementation Regulation, the DPA Guidance and the Alternative Dispute Resolution Procedure; no issue date is given (date is the article's published date).

The review describes mandatory registration of controllers of major importance within six months and annual audit reports under the Authority's guidance, with no decision or count reported (date is the article's published date).

slug: 2024-02-26 Somalia inaugurates its Data Protection Authority

facts.fact: Somalia inaugurated its Data Protection Authority on 24 February 2024, following the Data Protection Law No. 005 of 2023.
The law was ratified by both parliamentary chambers and signed by the President in March 2023; the article gives no commencement date and does not say it is in force.
At the beginning of February 2024 the Authority published guidelines for implementing the law, setting compliance steps; no decision or sanction is reported.

The text is Law No. 005 of 2023, the Data Protection Act, which provides in Article 43 that it comes into force on adoption by the Federal Parliament, promulgation by the President and publication in the Official Bulletin, and in Article 5(2) exempts controllers that are not of major importance until the second anniversary of coming into force; the document gives no date, so the published date of 2023-03-22 is used.

Article 6 establishes the Data Protection Authority as an independent agency, constituted on adoption and promulgation of the law and appointment of a General Manager (proposed by the Minister, confirmed by the Cabinet, appointed by the President, Article 13), with a Board of up to nine members to be appointed within two years of the law coming into force (Article 8); the document names no appointee, and the published date of 2023-03-22 is used.
